individualism--noun.def: The belief that personal freedom matters more than group demands.

surrealism--noun.def: An art movement that shows strange dreamlike images.

spurious--adj.def: False, though appearing genuine or reasonable.
spurious--adj.ex: The claim rests on spurious data.

mangle--verb.def: To damage something badly by crushing or tearing.

opulent--adj.ex: They dined in an opulent hall.

proliferation--noun.def: A rapid increase in the number of something.
proliferation--noun.ex: The proliferation of apps confuses users.

additive--noun.def: A substance added to food or fuel to change it.

additive--adj.def: Made by adding parts together one after another.
additive--adj.ex: The effects are additive, not separate.

parochial--adj.def: Interested only in local matters, or belonging to a parish.

singe--verb.def: To burn the surface of something slightly.

recitation--noun.def: The act of saying a poem or list aloud from memory.
recitation--noun.ex: The lesson ended with a recitation.

anthropological--adj.def: Relating to the study of human societies and cultures.

allot--verb.def: To give a share of time, money or space to someone.
allot--verb.ex: Each speaker is allotted ten minutes.

puritanical--adj.def: Very strict about morals and disapproving of pleasure.
puritanical--adj.ex: His puritanical rules emptied the club.

exude--verb.def: To give off a quality or liquid steadily.

interlocking--adj.def: Fitting into one another so the parts hold together.

resound--verb.def: To fill a place with loud sound.

contemptuous--adj.def: Showing that you think someone deserves no respect.

sterility--noun.def: The inability to produce young, or freedom from germs.
sterility--noun.ex: Sterility of the tools is essential.

centralized--adj.ex: The state has a centralized system.

inexorably--adv.def: In a way that cannot be stopped or changed.
inexorably--adv.exTr: Maliyetler her yıl durdurulamaz biçimde arttı.

acreage--noun.def: The size of a piece of land measured in acres.
acreage--noun.ex: They doubled the acreage under wheat.
acreage--noun.exTr: Buğday ekili arazi büyüklüğünü ikiye katladılar.

forfeiture--noun.def: The loss of property or a right as a punishment.
forfeiture--noun.ex: The court ordered forfeiture of the boat.

tactically--adv.def: In a way planned to gain an advantage.

ardor--noun.ex: He defended the plan with ardor.

cloistered--adj.def: Kept safely away from the difficulties of ordinary life.
cloistered--adj.ex: He led a cloistered academic life.
cloistered--adj.exTr: Dünyadan kopuk, akademik bir hayat sürdü.

ravish--verb.def: To fill someone with delight, in literary use.

unequivocal--adj.def: Leaving no doubt about the meaning.

impeccably--adv.def: In a way that has no fault at all.

inexorable--adj.def: Continuing without any chance of being stopped.
inexorable--adj.ex: The inexorable rise of costs worries them.

outmoded--adj.def: No longer useful because newer things exist.

epoxy--noun.def: A very strong glue made of two mixed parts.

patchy--adj.def: Good in some parts and poor in others.
patchy--adj.ex: His knowledge of the period is patchy.
patchy--adj.exTr: Döneme dair bilgisi yer yer eksik.

abhorrently--adv.def: In a way that causes strong moral disgust.

accrue--verb.def: To increase in amount over time, as interest does.
accrue--verb.ex: Interest accrues from the first day.

acrobatically--adv.ex: He leapt acrobatically over the bar.

ad-lib--adj.ex: His ad-lib remarks got the biggest laugh.
ad-lib--adj.exTr: Doğaçlama sözleri en büyük kahkahayı aldı.

ad-lib--verb.def: To speak or perform without a script.
ad-lib--verb.ex: The host ad-libbed for five minutes.

adhesion--noun.def: The sticking of one surface to another.
adhesion--noun.ex: Dust reduces adhesion of the tape.

adornment--noun.def: Something added to make a thing more attractive.

adulterate--verb.def: To make a product weaker by adding something inferior.

affectation--noun.def: Unnatural behaviour adopted to impress others.

aghast--adj.ex: She stood aghast at the damage.
aghast--adj.exTr: Hasar karşısında dehşete düşmüş hâlde durdu.

all-encompassing--adj.exTr: Her şeyi kapsayan bir kuram sundu.

allegorical--adj.def: Using characters or events to stand for wider ideas.

allude--verb.def: To mention something indirectly rather than openly.
allude--verb.ex: He alluded to the quarrel once.

allusion--noun.ex: The poem is full of classical allusion.

amorphous--adj.def: Having no clear shape or structure.
amorphous--adj.ex: The group is large but amorphous.

amorphously--adv.def: Without any definite shape or organisation.
amorphously--adv.ex: The crowd spread amorphously across the square.

anarchic--adj.def: Without order or respect for rules.
anarchic--adj.ex: The office had an anarchic charm.

angsty--adj.def: Full of anxious worry about life, in informal use.

angularity--noun.def: The quality of having sharp corners or visible bones.
angularity--noun.ex: The angularity of the roof is striking.

antediluvian--adj.def: Extremely old-fashioned, as if from before the great flood.

anthology--noun.def: A book collecting poems or stories by different writers.

anthropologically--adv.def: From the point of view of the study of human cultures.

anticlimactically--adv.def: In a way that ends far less excitingly than expected.
anticlimactically--adv.exTr: Dava hayal kırıklığı yaratacak biçimde kapandı.

antithesis--noun.ex: Her style is the antithesis of his.

antithetical--adj.def: Directly opposed to something in nature.

arcanely--adv.def: In a way only a few specialists can follow.

archetypal--adj.def: Showing the most typical qualities of its kind.
archetypal--adj.ex: He is the archetypal village doctor.

archival--adj.def: Relating to records kept for long-term study.

arduously--adv.def: With a great deal of long and tiring effort.
arduously--adv.ex: They climbed arduously to the ridge.

articulation--noun.def: Clear expression of an idea, or the forming of speech sounds.
articulation--noun.ex: Her articulation of the plan convinced us.
articulation--noun.exTr: Planı ifade edişi bizi ikna etti.

artifice--noun.def: Clever trickery used to deceive or impress.

astringent--noun.def: A liquid that tightens the skin and closes pores.

athleticism--noun.def: Strength and skill in physical movement.

attributive--adj.def: Placed before a noun to describe it, in grammar.

austerely--adv.def: In a plain, strict way without comfort or decoration.

automate--verb.def: To make a process run by machine instead of by people.

axiom--noun.def: A statement accepted as true without proof.
axiom--noun.ex: Geometry begins with a few axioms.

axiomatic--adj.def: So clearly true that it needs no proof.
axiomatic--adj.ex: It is axiomatic that markets need rules.

belligerence--noun.def: An eagerness to fight or argue.

besiege--verb.def: To surround a place with an army, or to crowd around someone.

blandishment--noun.def: Flattering words used to persuade someone.

blubbery--adj.ex: The seal has a blubbery layer.

blurb--noun.def: A short praising description on a book cover.
blurb--noun.exTr: Tanıtım yazısı bir gerilim vaat ediyor.

bona-fide--adj.def: Genuine and made in good faith.
bona-fide--adj.ex: He is a bona fide buyer.

brandish--verb.def: To wave something, especially a weapon, in a threatening way.
brandish--verb.ex: He brandished a stick at them.
